hook: Strategy just sold $216M of its Bitcoin

stories.text: Strategy sells $216M in Bitcoin for dividend payout
stories.summary: Strategy sold $216 million worth of Bitcoin to cover its dividend payments, raising questions about the sustainability of its Bitcoin-heavy corporate strategy.

stories.text: Metaplanet explores Bitcoin-backed bonds for Japanese investors
stories.summary: Metaplanet is studying a plan to issue bonds backed by Bitcoin, using a yen stablecoin and security tokens via Progmat, targeting Japanese investors.

stories.text: Polymarket applies for US margin trading license to catch rival Kalshi
stories.summary: Polymarket is seeking a U.S. license for margin trading to compete with Kalshi, which already holds one and has racked up over $5.5 billion in volume.

stories.text: Crypto ETFs bleed $147M with Bitcoin and Ether leading losses
stories.summary: Crypto ETFs saw $147 million in outflows on July 9, led by $95.3 million from Bitcoin funds and $52.2 million from Ether funds.

stories.text: DeFi tokens outperform Bitcoin in June 2026 led by Hyperliquid
stories.summary: DeFi tokens showed resilience in June 2026, with Hyperliquid up 160% year-to-date and Aave generating $900 million in revenue as institutions enter the space.
